exams.name: Written examination for certified contractor
exams.notes: Applicant failing first exam may take a subsequent written or practical examination within six months. Applicants must stand for examination within one year from date board receives application and fees.
exams.quote: All prospective certified contractors in this state seeking to qualify in accordance with this chapter shall be required to stand for a written examination before the board.

available.quote: The board may enter into reciprocity agreements with other states to permit Alabama certified contractors to engage in work in other states in exchange for that state's contractors being permitted to perform work in Alabama.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business as a certified contractor or performing the functions of a certified contractor in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any individual engaged in business as a certified contractor or performing the functions of a certified contractor in violation of this chapter shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to renew certificate by December 31 of each year, resulting in late penalties or removal of certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may impose late penalties on certified contractors who fail to renew certificates by December 31 of each year.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may reprimand, in writing, any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Otherwise violating the provisions of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may remove, revoke, or suspend the certification of any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to immediately comply with a cease and desist order issued by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the person fails to immediately comply with the cease and desist order, the board shall petition any court of competent jurisdiction to issue a writ of injunction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with minimum repair and service standards adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certified contractors who fail to comply with such minimum standards and criteria shall be punished as prescribed in Section 34-31-32(a).

bonding_required.quote: The board may require a performance bond not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) per year for all active certified contractors.
